units: inches (as interpreted by original HTML viewer; GLB has no unit metadata)
axisConvention: axisU points to the first outer-ring vertex pair midpoint; axisV follows stored perimeter order; axisU cross axisV = -normal; normal points toward previous section (neck to tail).
sourceDescription: 34 body ribs followed by 4 further upper-head ribs; shared neck rib deduplicated. Three lower-jaw ribs are separate. No invented nose-tail join.
